tasks.title: pipeline/db.py: Domain, DomainSnapshot, DomainQuote, DomainPurchase tables
tasks.notes: Research Finding 1: portfolio is state, not CollectedItem. Domain: name (lower-case punycode, unique), ownership owned|watched, source (namecheap|godaddy|wordpress|manual), connection_id nullable, registrar fields (expires_at, auto_renew, locked, privacy) nullable, first_seen/last_seen, missing_since. DomainSnapshot: domain_id, taken_at, data JSON, data_hash. DomainQuote: uuid id, name, connection_id, price/renewal_price as str decimals, currency, premium, expires_at. DomainPurchase: quote_id UNIQUE, status pending|succeeded|failed|unknown, price, created_at, detail (redacted). New tables via create_all; nullable/defaulted columns only (db.py:83 comment). Tests: unique name, unique quote_id raises IntegrityError.

tasks.title: pipeline/connections.py: namecheap, godaddy, wordpress connection kinds with validation
tasks.notes: Research Finding 2. namecheap: label, api_user, username, client_ip (IPv4 only; Namecheap FAQ), sandbox (true|false, optional); secrets api_key (required), registrant_contact (optional JSON). godaddy: label, environment (production|ote, optional default production); secrets api_key, api_secret (required), registrant_contact optional. wordpress: label, client_id, redirect_mode (optional); secrets client_secret (required), access_token (optional, set by sign-in). Labels [a-z0-9]+ max 32 in _LABEL_RULES. materialize() emits nothing for these kinds (adapters read via get_secret); registrar keys are UI-only, not seeded from .env. registrant_contact validated as JSON object with required keys first_name,last_name,address1,city,state_province,postal_code,country,phone,email.

tasks.title: pipeline/domains package: settings, normalize_domain, registrar protocol and result types
tasks.notes: Research Implementation Step 1. normalize_domain: strip, lower, trailing dot, IDNA to punycode, reject labels >63, total >253, no scheme/path; returns (name, tld). domain_settings() reads via pipeline.health.env(): DOMAINS_PURCHASE_ENABLED (default false), DOMAINS_MAX_PRICE (default 25), DOMAINS_DAILY_CAP (default 50), DOMAINS_ALLOW_PREMIUM (default false), DOMAINS_REFRESH_CRON (default '30 5 * * *'), DOMAINS_RESOLVER (optional); invalid numbers fail closed (purchase disabled). Registrar Protocol: list_domains, check, purchase, check_connection. Typed status errors: NotEligible, IpNotWhitelisted, RateLimited, AuthFailed, Unsupported, RegistrarError. Decimal prices, never float. scope+tests/conftest.py

tasks.title: Namecheap adapter: getList, check, create, getBalances over XML with defusedxml
tasks.notes: Research Finding 3, Step 2. requests (codebase convention), timeout 30. getList paged PageSize=100; check batch size is UNVERIFIED (~50): chunk at 50 and make the constant obvious. Map Status=ERROR messages to IpNotWhitelisted / NotEligible / AuthFailed. check_connection returns detail naming current egress IPv4 (api.ipify.org) so the UI can say 'whitelist X'. create needs all 4 contact roles from registrant_contact; returns charged amount. Tests stub requests at module import site (tests/test_collectors.py:47 pattern) with XML fixture strings; include an XXE payload test that must not resolve.

tasks.title: GoDaddy adapter: v1 list, available, agreements + purchase, typed 403/429 handling
tasks.notes: Research Finding 4. Single _auth_headers() function (PAT migration risk). GET /v1/domains with marker pagination; POST /v1/domains/available (chunks of 500, checkType=FULL) — price is micro-units (divide by 1_000_000; verify against docs at build time); 403 ACCESS_DENIED/ACCOUNT_NOT_ELIGIBLE -> NotEligible('availability needs >=50 domains or 0/mo spend'); 429 -> RateLimited with RateLimit-Reset. purchase: GET /v1/domains/agreements?tlds=&privacy=false, then POST /v1/domains/purchase with consent.agreementKeys/agreedAt/agreedBy, privacy false, no add-ons. Tests stub requests.

tasks.title: pipeline/oauth_wordpress.py: WordPress.com auth-code sign-in storing access_token
tasks.notes: Research Q3 / Finding 2. Mirror pipeline/oauth_gmail.py + oauth_google.py structure (start / complete, paste_back and callback modes, state check via oauth_flows). authorize https://public-api.wordpress.com/oauth2/authorize scope=global; token exchange stores access_token secret via connections.set_secret. tasks.title: WordPress.com adapter: best-effort /rest/v1.1/all-domains inventory, read-only
tasks.notes: Research Q3, Dissent. Undocumented endpoint: parse defensively (unknown shape -> RegistrarError with 'response shape changed', never KeyError); accept list under 'domains' key; map domain/expiry/auto_renew where present, else None. check()/purchase() raise Unsupported. 403 authorization_required -> AuthFailed('sign in again').

tasks.title: pipeline/domains/dns.py: DNS records and mail posture (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MTA-STS, BIMI)
tasks.notes: Research Finding 5. dnspython sync resolver, nameservers from DOMAINS_RESOLVER when set; A AAAA CNAME MX NS TXT SOA CAA; NXDOMAIN/NoAnswer are data not errors. mail_posture: SPF present/count/lookup count <=10, DMARC p=, DKIM selectors (google, selector1, selector2, k1, default), _mta-sts TXT + policy fetch, BIMI; flag 'parked domain without v=spf1 -all / p=reject'. Bounded ThreadPoolExecutor. Tests inject a fake resolver (true external), no network.

tasks.title: pipeline/domains/rdap.py: RDAP registration data via whoisit with per-TLD unsupported state
tasks.notes: Research Q4, Finding 5. Result: status ok|not_found|unsupported|error, registrar, created, expires, nameservers, epp statuses (normalized camelCase), locked = transfer-prohibited present. Bootstrap once per process (whoisit.bootstrap), TLD missing from bootstrap -> unsupported (e.g. .de). 404 -> not_found (availability signal, not authoritative). Tests stub whoisit calls.

tasks.title: pipeline/domains/intel.py: crt.sh subdomains and Wayback CDX URLs, best-effort
tasks.notes: Research Q4 ('url search' interpreted as URL/subdomain intel). crt.sh ?q=%25.<d>&output=json, 5 req/min and frequent 502: one retry with backoff, then status unavailable; dedupe/limit subdomains (<=500), strip wildcards. Wayback CDX collapse=urlkey limit 200. On-demand only (not in daily refresh). urlscan/VirusTotal out of scope (key + ToS).

tasks.title: pipeline/domains/snapshot.py: inspect() assembles DNS+RDAP+mail, hash and diff to change events
tasks.notes: Research Finding 5 snapshot fields. Each part records ok|error|unsupported without failing the whole. data_hash over normalized (sorted) fields. diff(prev, cur, domain) -> list[Change(kind, summary)] for: ns_changed, mx_changed, a_changed, lock_removed, expiry_soon (<=30 and <=7 days when auto_renew is not True), auto_renew_off, mail_posture_regressed, redemption (watched domains). Pure functions for diff; inspect takes injectable lookups for tests.

tasks.title: pipeline/domains/inventory.py: registrar factory, sync, manual/CSV add, snapshot refresh
tasks.notes: Research Decision Phase A/B. registrar_for(connection_id) builds adapter from connections.get/get_secret. sync_all(): per registrar connection list_domains -> upsert Domain (registrar fields win for their own source), set missing_since for vanished rows (never delete), one connection failing does not stop others; returns per-connection status. add_manual(name, ownership), remove, import_csv(text) accepts 'domain[,ownership]' rows, reports rejects. refresh_snapshots(): inspect each domain, store DomainSnapshot only when hash changed (plus always one per day max for history). Tests use a fake Registrar object (in-process, not mocking src/ modules under test) and the test DB.

tasks.notes: Research Finding 1 (scheduler.py:46 single job). Cron from domain_settings().refresh_cron (invalid -> default + warning), same timezone handling as reschedule(). Job runs sync_all then refresh_snapshots; exceptions caught and logged by class name (redaction rule). Must run before the digest's schedule_cron by default (05:30). Existing daily_digest_run behavior unchanged.

tasks.title: Digest: 'domains' source whose collector emits snapshot-diff alerts in the window
tasks.notes: Research Finding 1 PROPOSAL, Implementation Step 5. 4 files (soft-warn band): known_sources() + check_all_configured() in health.py must both learn 'domains' because runner.py:304-311 only collects healthy sources. check_domains is local (DB count), ok even with 0 domains. collect_domains(since, until) returns Item(item_type='domain_alert', external_id=f'{name}:{kind}:{snapshot_id}') for diffs of snapshots taken in [since, until) plus expiry_soon computed at until. No network in the collector.

tasks.title: pipeline/domains/ideas.py: combinatorial + optional Claude name ideas with private local prefilter
tasks.notes: Research Q5, Finding 6. generate_candidates(seeds, tlds, affixes, max_len, allow_hyphen) deterministic, capped (<=500), normalized via normalize_domain. llm_ideas(brief, n) reuses pipeline/triage.py make_client()/llm_settings (anthropic already pinned), structured JSON output, model output treated as untrusted (normalize + drop invalid), degrades to [] with a reason when LLM unconfigured. prefilter(names) = DNS NXDOMAIN + RDAP not_found -> 'likely_available'; any record -> 'taken'; unsupported -> 'unknown'. Never calls a registrar or third-party search site (front-running).

tasks.title: pipeline/domains/purchase.py: server-side quote, guarded idempotent purchase, reconcile unknown
tasks.notes: Research Q6, Implementation Step 4. create_quote(name, connection_id) -> registrar.check -> DomainQuote (TTL 5 min). execute_purchase(quote_id, confirm_name, years=1) refuses (typed PurchaseRefused(reason)) unless: purchase enabled, quote unexpired, confirm_name == quote.name, available, not premium unless DOMAINS_ALLOW_PREMIUM, price <= max_price, today's succeeded+pending+unknown total + price <= daily_cap, registrant_contact present. Insert DomainPurchase(pending) BEFORE registrar call (unique quote_id => second call refused); timeout/unknown -> status unknown, never auto-retry. On success add Domain(owned). reconcile_unknown() marks unknown as succeeded when sync_all shows the domain. Tests: every refusal path, double submit, registrar timeout -> unknown, success creates Domain.

tasks.title: api/routers/domains.py: inventory list/detail, sync, manual add, CSV import, on-demand inspect
tasks.notes: Research Finding 8. Plain def handlers (blocking network, connections.py router pattern). GET /domains (filter owned|watched, source), GET /domains/{name} (latest snapshot + last 30 snapshots summary), POST /domains (manual add), DELETE /domains/{name} (manual/watched only), POST /domains/import (CSV text body, size-capped), POST /domains/sync (sync_all + refresh), POST /domains/inspect {name, intel: bool} for any domain without persisting. Errors are generic {code,message}; no registrar response bodies echoed. Mutations inherit CSRF header check (api/security.py:36) — test that a POST without X-Requested-With is 403.

tasks.title: api/routers/domain_buy.py: ideas, availability check, quotes, purchases, purchase history
